top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new chemical modality: a designed small molecule recruits a ubiquitin ligase to a chosen protein, with a physical-organic mechanism (ternary-complex cooperativity, linker design, the cereblon degron) confirmed independently for two decades. Crews and Deshaies supply the PROTAC concept and Handa the cereblon mechanism behind approved glue drugs, so one citation worded around induced proximity covers both strands. Credit is the weak point (Ciulli, Sakamoto, Gray, Ito, Kim are omitted), but the citation names both routes without claiming a single history. P002 is a mature, cleanly attributed but later chapter of a field honoured in 2010, so it ranks second and above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai are not candidates, and no candidate in P001 or P002 is linked to Lund
